rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/cost/v1/containers/:containerId/cost-items:detach
User context required
data:write
JSON

Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow.
The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified as three-legged because it preserves user context.
Must be application/json

Specifies the region where the project data resides.
By default, the request is routed automatically. However, specifying the region can improve performance by avoiding lookup overhead.
Possible values: country or region codes such as US or EMEA. For the full list of supported regions, see the Forma Regions page.
To verify your project’s region, refer to the Working with BIM 360 Services in Different Regions section on the API Basics page.
The ID of the project (the container ID is the same as the project ID). To obtain the project ID, see GET projects.
The ID of the change order to which the cost item is attached.
The ID of the cost item to detach.
